components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background:hsl(210 40% 98%);color:hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2%);border:0;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 16px;height:40px;font:500 14px sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:hsl(210 40% 98% / .9); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(212.7 26.8% 83.9%); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Outline button
components.css: .ds-button-outline { background:transparent;color:inherit;border:1px solid hsl(217.2 32.6% 17.5%);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 16px;height:40px;font:500 14px sans-serif; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background:hsl(210 40% 98%);color:hsl(217.2 32.6% 17.5%); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(212.7 26.8% 83.9%); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio pairs charcoal surfaces and mint accents with a Georama type stack. Keep the interface quiet enough for simulation diagrams, game screenshots, and development notes to carry the visual interest.
